scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build --workspace @do-we-stream-it/scraper-queue && npm run dev --workspace @do-we-stream-it/worker
scripts.scraper:enqueue: npm run build --workspace @do-we-stream-it/scraper-queue && npm run enqueue --workspace @do-we-stream-it/worker --
scripts.scraper:preview: npm run build --workspace @do-we-stream-it/scraper-queue && npm run preview-source --workspace @do-we-stream-it/worker --
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @do-we-stream-it/scraper-queue && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test:worker: npm run build --workspace @do-we-stream-it/scraper-queue && npm run test --workspace @do-we-stream-it/scraper-queue && npm run test --workspace @do-we-stream-it/worker
scripts.test:worker:integration: npm run build --workspace @do-we-stream-it/scraper-queue && npm run test:integration --workspace @do-we-stream-it/worker
